잠언 16:1.content: The preparations of the heart in man, and the answer of the tongue, is from the Lord.

잠언 16:2.content: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes; but the Lord weigheth the spirits.

잠언 16:3.content: Commit thy works unto the Lord, and thy thoughts shall be established.

잠언 16:4.content: The Lord hath made all things for himself: yea, even the wicked for the day of evil.

잠언 16:5.content: Every one that is proud in heart is an abomination to the Lord: though hand join in hand, he shall not be unpunished.

잠언 16:6.content: By mercy and truth iniquity is purged: and by the fear of the Lord men depart from evil.

잠언 16:7.content: When a man’s ways please the Lord, he maketh even his enemies to be at peace with him.

잠언 16:8.content: Better is a little with righteousness than great revenues without right.

잠언 16:9.content: A man’s heart deviseth his way: but the Lord directeth his steps.

잠언 16:10.content: A divine sentence is in the lips of the king: his mouth transgresseth not in judgment.

잠언 16:11.content: A just weight and balance are the Lord’s: all the weights of the bag are his work.

잠언 16:12.content: It is an abomination to kings to commit wickedness: for the throne is established by righteousness.

잠언 16:13.content: Righteous lips are the delight of kings; and they love him that speaketh right.

잠언 16:14.content: The wrath of a king is as messengers of death: but a wise man will pacify it.

잠언 16:15.content: In the light of the king’s countenance is life; and his favour is as a cloud of the latter rain.

잠언 16:16.content: How much better is it to get wisdom than gold! and to get understanding rather to be chosen than silver!

잠언 16:17.content: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil: he that keepeth his way preserveth his soul.

잠언 16:18.content: Pride goeth before destruction, and an haughty spirit before a fall.

잠언 16:19.content: Better it is to be of an humble spirit with the lowly, than to divide the spoil with the proud.

잠언 16:20.content: He that handleth a matter wisely shall find good: and whoso trusteth in the Lord, happy is he.

잠언 16:21.content: The wise in heart shall be called prudent: and the sweetness of the lips increaseth learning.

잠언 16:22.content: Understanding is a wellspring of life unto him that hath it: but the instruction of fools is folly.

잠언 16:23.content: The heart of the wise teacheth his mouth, and addeth learning to his lips.

잠언 16:24.content: Pleasant words are as an honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

잠언 16:25.content: There is a way that seemeth right unto a man, but the end thereof are the ways of death.

잠언 16:26.content: He that laboureth laboureth for himself; for his mouth craveth it of him.

잠언 16:27.content: An ungodly man diggeth up evil: and in his lips there is as a burning fire.

잠언 16:28.content: A froward man soweth strife: and a whisperer separateth chief friends.

잠언 16:29.content: A violent man enticeth his neighbour, and leadeth him into the way that is not good.

잠언 16:30.content: He shutteth his eyes to devise froward things: moving his lips he bringeth evil to pass.

잠언 16:31.content: The hoary head is a crown of glory, if it be found in the way of righteousness.

잠언 16:32.content: He that is slow to anger is better than the mighty; and he that ruleth his spirit than he that taketh a city.

잠언 16:33.content: The lot is cast into the lap; but the whole disposing thereof is of the Lord.
